title: Book Two · Chapter 154: The Wrong Pile
story:
The second practice takes place on Tuesday. Six paper cards lie in front of Ronan. A page of instructions lies beside them.

Three cards are for the reading room. Two are for the classroom. The last card has no name on it. It has no room number either.

The page says to keep the unnamed card on the desk and ask the teacher about it. Ronan reads the line. Then he begins to make his piles.

He puts the three reading room cards on the left. The two classroom cards go on the right. He looks at the last card. A small picture of a chair is on it. The reading room has those chairs.

He adds it to the left pile.

Miss Wu asks him to explain his work. Ronan points to the picture.

“This goes to the reading room too.”

“Which line tells you that?”

He reads the instruction page again. His finger stops halfway down.

“I need to keep it here,” he says.

“Yes. For this task, the words give you the rule. The picture does not give you a room number.”

“Can I change it?”

“You can correct the practice now. The first result still needs to show the mistake.”

He takes the card from the pile. It takes only a moment. Still, he wishes no one could see his hand.

After the others finish, he stays to ask a question.

“Does that mean this result cannot count?”

“It cannot count as a good result without help. But you can practise with it again.”

Ronan nods, but his face feels hot. He has one good result so far. Four tasks are left. He needs three of those to go well without help.

Outside, Leo stands beside the water tap.

“How was it?” he asks.

“One wrong card.”

“The empty one?”

“Yes.”

“I nearly moved that too.”

Ronan wants to ask if nearly means the same as wrong. He knows the answer. Leo left the card on the desk. Ronan did not.

They walk toward the yard. Jun is helping a younger boy find a lost ball under a bench. Ronan bends to look from the other end.

“I can see it,” he says.

“Can you reach it?” Jun asks.

Ronan tries. His arm is too short. He pulls it back and looks for a stick.

Jun stops him. “I can get it from this side.”

Jun kneels and reaches through the open back of the bench. The ball rolls free. The younger boy catches it with both hands and thanks them.

Ronan brushes dust from his knee. Jun picks up his own bag.

“Good eyes,” Jun says.

“Short arms,” Ronan answers.

Jun smiles a little. Then he goes toward Mei. Ronan watches him leave, takes a drink of water, and follows Leo to the gate.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pile＝一叠、一堆；unnamed＝未写名字的；count as＝算作、计为；instruction＝指示。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么把无名卡片放错地方？
2. count as a good result without help在这里指什么？这次更正后能计入吗？

## 读句子

**He takes the card from the pile.**

拆开看：He / takes / the card from the pile.

他／拿出／那叠中的卡片。
